title: clematis viorna var. parviflora
intro: Clematis viorna var. parviflora, commonly known as Virgin's Bower, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family, native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clematis viorna var. parviflora include soothing coughs and relieving congestion, as well as reducing fever and pain. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
